raw_text: This Node.js addon binds Nacos via napi-rs/nacos-sdk-rust. Rust: `src/*.rs`; `lib.rs` entry/`ClientOptions`, `config.rs` config client, `naming.rs` naming client, `plugin.rs` encryption/decryption filter. `index.d.ts` auto-generated. Rust `Option<T>` maps to TypeScript `T | undefined | null`; async methods return Promises; callbacks use `ThreadsafeFunction`; Nacos errors become JS `Error` with reason strings. Clients maintain persistent gRPC connections and are statefu
